verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25706253 from Boise Semiconductor to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318585 (dated 2025-11-26): item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 10,500 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed delivery date 2025-12-29. Incoterms EXW Boise, payment NET30. The delivery terms text is internally inconsistent: EXW, yet freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by the Seller and added to the invoice.
red_flags: Terms contradict each other: EXW Boise normally means the buyer arranges and pays freight, insurance and duties, but the document says these are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice (while stating DDP is not agreed). This could add unexpected charges to the invoice.
The document has no total price or currency total, and no explicit document date.
The 'Qty' column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed quantity; the 'Confirmed' column holds only a date.
observations: Clean printed document with no handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
The description wraps over three lines ('Game Card 64 / GB – Grand / Heist 5').
Quantity uses an English thousands separator (10,500 = 10500).
The quantity is recorded as quantity_ordered because the column is just 'Qty'. Only the delivery date is shown as confirmed.
